about: COMBAT MAPS 3, rule 346(b): nothing stands where it could not. A by-eye list per place, checked on its board in the live fight (the card's AFTER and IN PLAY shots), tied to the sha1 of its block pictures (gates/every_place_no_seams_gate.js): a changed picture is a list nobody has checked yet.

strip.by: COMBAT MAPS 3, by eye on the live fight's shots

checks.what: every car, cab and wreck stands in a lane of the Boulevard (columns 1 and 3 of its blocks), none on the median, a sidewalk or a forecourt; the cab at the drop-off stands on the drop-off lane
checks.how: block pictures blvd.1, blvd.2, stripw.1 and the AFTER shot

checks.what: the bridge spans kerb to median on its pier, its stair tower stands on the sidewalk, and the limo lies in the lane south of it, not under its deck
every drive off the Boulevard runs across both sidewalks into a frontage's drop-off lane at the same two rows; none runs into a wall or a tower
checks.how: the road leg (0 of 51 seams) and the pictures

checks.what: the fallen arrow sign lies across the east frontage's drive on open ground, not through the tower or the porte-cochere's posts
palms stand in their planters on paving (sidewalks, median, forecourts), never on the asphalt

no open tile has a tall mass south of it (the camera looks north: a tower's roof would be drawn over the tile behind it); the towers fill their whole columns, the porte-cochere roofs are their own height tiles
checks.how: the tiles of all six blocks

checks.what: the valet's last cars stand nose-in on the forecourt beside the door, not on the drop-off lane; the valet stand and its rope on the lane's kerb

the dead lie only where nobody was left to move them (rule 360 amended): body bags in rows on the casino forecourts that became morgues, a body on a bench and under a tarp, the luggage dropped along the sidewalks; none on a road's lane or a marked piece
checks.how: the pictures, COOK DEAD's models placed by hand (DEAD in the tool)

downtown.by: COMBAT MAPS 3, by eye on the live fight's shots

checks.what: three streets run east to west whole through every block of their rows (Fremont East, the Fremont mall, the service alley and Ogden Avenue); no street starts from nothing
checks.how: fremont.10-15 pictures and the road leg (0 of 51)

checks.what: every front faces the camera or the alley: the old casino fronts at street level with their marquees face the mall, the motel, the pawn shop, the garage and the chapel face Fremont East; nothing tall stands south of open ground (the south side's shops are one storey)
the canopy came down: its columns stand on the mall's two sides, one bay still standing, its ribs and screens lie in the street as cover, one panel still lit; no structure is drawn over the street

roof to roof (his): the south side's shops (one storey), their backs (two and three storeys) and the garages are walked roof to roof, each at its own storey, up the fire escapes and the garage ramps; the motel's walkway and the garage decks are the high ground on Fremont East
checks.how: the roof storeys in ours.roof_storeys and the pictures

checks.what: the Deuce lies burnt on Fremont East, a street, on its own two blocked tiles; the cars stand on streets and in the motel's court, the dumpsters on the back lot and in the alley
no building or thing reaches past its block's side; the south side's backs stand on their own rows with the alley open before them
checks.how: the edge leg and fremont.14, fremont.15 pictures (a first render had them over the alley: fixed)

checks.what: the dead lie only where nobody was left to move them (rule 360 amended): in a casino's doorway under its marquee, on the mall's sidewalk, under a tarp in the back lot and the alley; graves only in the chapel's yard, where somebody stayed; none on a road's lane or a marked piece
checks.how: the pictures, COOK DEAD's models placed by hand (DEAD in the tool)

checks.what: the pallets stand beside the cold-store truck's open doors inside the block; no shed or roof reaches past the picture's edge

wash.by: COMBAT MAPS 3, by eye on the live fight's shots

the camp's tents and tarps stand on the bank, never in the channel; the fence lines' gravel is a soft strip
